script.setup:
const s=ctx.state,gl=ctx.gl;s.canvas=new OffscreenCanvas(1,1);s.c=s.canvas.getContext('2d');s.texture=gl.createTexture();s.program=ctx.utils.createProgram(ctx.utils.FULLSCREEN_VERTEX_SHADER,`#version 300 es
precision highp float;in vec2 v_uv;out vec4 outColor;uniform sampler2D u_image;void main(){outColor=texture(u_image,vec2(v_uv.x,1.-v_uv.y));}`);s.mount=()=>{const div=document.createElement('div');div.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:-10000px;top:0;width:512px;height:512px;overflow:hidden';document.body.appendChild(div);return div;};s.colors=['#57d8c6','#ffbc78','#ad9bff'];const [mod,gmod]=await Promise.all([ctx.utils.import('https://esm.sh/sigma@3.0.3?bundle'),ctx.utils.import('https://esm.sh/graphology@0.26.0?bundle')]);const Graph=gmod.default??gmod;const Sigma=mod.default??mod;s.div=s.mount();s.network=new Graph();for(let i=0;i<30;i++){const a=(i%10)/10*Math.PI*2,g=Math.floor(i/10),b=g*Math.PI*2/3;s.network.addNode('n'+i,{x:Math.cos(b)+.38*Math.cos(a),y:Math.sin(b)+.38*Math.sin(a),size:6,color:s.colors[g]});}for(let i=0;i<30;i++)s.network.addEdge('n'+i,'n'+(Math.floor(i/10)*10+(i+1)%10));for(let i=0;i<10;i++)s.network.addEdge('n'+i,'n'+(10+i));for(let i=0;i<10;i++)s.network.addEdge('n'+(10+i),'n'+(20+i));s.sigma=new Sigma(s.network,s.div,{renderLabels:false,defaultEdgeColor:'#496779',defaultEdgeType:'line',zIndex:true});
script.render: const s=ctx.state,u=ctx.uniforms,c=s.c,gl=ctx.gl,[w,h]=ctx.resolution,m=Math.min(w,h),size=m*.82,left=(w-size)/2,top=(h-size)/2,key=JSON.stringify(u);if(s.error)throw Error(s.error);if(s.canvas.width!==w||s.canvas.height!==h){s.canvas.width=w;s.canvas.height=h;}c.fillStyle='#0b1625';c.fillRect(0,0,w,h);if(s.key!==key){for(let i=0;i<30;i++){const a=(i%10)/10*Math.PI*2,b=Math.floor(i/10)*Math.PI*2/3;s.network.mergeNodeAttributes('n'+i,{x:Math.cos(b)*u.u_separation+.38*Math.cos(a),y:Math.sin(b)*u.u_separation+.38*Math.sin(a),size:u.u_size});}s.key=key;}s.sigma.refresh({schedule:false});for(const source of Object.values(s.sigma.getCanvases()))c.drawImage(source,left,top,size,size);s.note='30 nodes · 50 edges · Sigma WebGL';c.fillStyle='#b7c9d8';c.font=Math.max(11,m*.022)+'px sans-serif';c.textAlign='center';c.fillText(s.note||'',w/2,h/2+m*.465);ctx.publish('tool',s.note||'ready');gl.bindTexture(gl.TEXTURE_2D,s.texture);gl.texImage2D(gl.TEXTURE_2D,0,gl.RGBA,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,s.canvas);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MIN_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_MAG_FILTER,gl.LINEAR);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_S,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.texParameteri(gl.TEXTURE_2D,gl.TEXTURE_WRAP_T,gl.CLAMP_TO_EDGE);gl.useProgram(s.program);ctx.utils.bindTexture(s.program,'u_image',s.texture,0);ctx.utils.drawFullscreen(s.program);
